summary: Quanta Services, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of $2.0 billion aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes across three tranches: $500M 4.850% notes due 2029, $750M 5.300% notes due 2033, and $750M 5.550% notes due 2036, priced at 99.950%, 99.757%, and 99.696% of par respectively. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities, and have a change-of-control put at 101%. Settlement is expected August 6, 2026; no exchange listing is intended. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
